title: Notify the parent in the handler

slides.say: A Toggle keeps its own on state and should tell its parent when it changes. Calling on change from an Effect runs too late.
Toggle updates, React paints, then the Effect calls on change, and the parent updates in a second render pass.
Instead, update both in the same event handler. React batches the two updates into one render pass.

slides.text: Or lift the state up entirely and make Toggle controlled.
slides.say: You could also remove the state from Toggle completely, and let the parent own it through props.
